name: Title on Image Card
description: A square photo with only a title on it, over a gradient. The whole card is one link: its title link covers it. On hover, and while keyboard focus is on its title link, the photo zooms, and the title fades to Rain and is underlined. The card has no fill to change, because the photo covers it.
sources: The brand mockup (Arizona.edu Components > Cards, Adobe XD), linked from az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2350: the title's Rain color and underline on hover
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): .card.bg-cloud.hover: the 300ms ease-out color fade, used here for the title so the cards match
az-digital/arizona-bootstrap#2365 (design-reviewed): the square image, the title's blue gradient over its bottom half, and the title's 24px padding
Arizona Bootstrap 5.2: the title's 30px line height (.h5)

root.description: The card: a photo, with the title on it. It has no fill of its own, because the photo covers it.

border.width.$description: Card border width: none, since the photo fills the card.

image.description: The photo, which fills the whole card, cropped to a square if it has to be. It zooms in on hover and with keyboard focus, inside the card's corners.

aspect-ratio.width.$description: Photo shape: its width, against aspect-ratio.height. The photo is square.

aspect-ratio.height.$description: Photo shape: its height, against aspect-ratio.width. The photo is square.

transition.duration.$description: How long the image takes to zoom in, and back out. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the image still zooms.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the image zoom: ease. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.

scale.$description: How much the image grows on hover: 8% larger. Implementations use it as transform: scale().
How much the image grows while keyboard focus is on the card's link: the same as on hover.

title.description: The title, a link that covers the whole card, at the bottom of the photo. Behind it, a gradient covers the bottom half of the photo, from transparent at the top of that half to gradient.color at the bottom, so its White text stays readable on any photo. With keyboard focus, its ring is drawn in its own color, as on the Icon Card.

line-height.$description: Card title line height. The space below the title is measured from this line.

height.$description: How much of the photo the title's gradient covers, as a percentage of its height: the bottom half. Implementations use calc(var(--…) * 1%).

transition.duration.$description: How long the title's color takes to change on hover and with keyboard focus: the same fade as the Icon Card's colors. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion; the color still changes.

transition.easing.$description: Easing for the title's color change: ease-out, as on the Icon Card. Turned off when someone asks for reduced motion.
